scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: cat src/css/utilities/reset.css src/css/utilities/variables.css src/css/layouts/*.css src/css/components/*.css src/css/utilities/responsive.css > dist/styles.css
scripts.build:js: cat src/js/config/*.js src/js/services/*.js src/js/components/*.js src/js/utils/*.js src/js/app.js > dist/app.js
scripts.watch: npm run build && echo 'Watching for changes...'
